subject.title: fix(config): cap runtime session-store cache retention

question: Should OpenClaw accept the 16 MiB default runtime session-store cache cap and `OPENCLAW_SESSION_CACHE_MAX_BYTES` override as the upgrade tradeoff for large existing stores?
rationale: The code path is a focused bug fix, but config/default surfaces and changed cache residency for existing large stores are compatibility-sensitive policy choices that automation should not finalize.

options.title: Accept The Cap
options.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB default as the intended memory-safety tradeoff for oversized session stores.

options.title: Tune Before Merge
options.body: Adjust the default threshold or env behavior if maintainers want large production stores to remain cacheable by default.

options.title: Pause For Longer Proof
options.body: Wait for soak or restart-recovery proof if maintainers require broader memory-floor evidence before changing default cache residency.

recommendation.title: Accept The Cap
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB default as the intended memory-safety tradeoff for oversized session stores.
